usedFor: Gallabox holds your customer conversations and Google Sheets holds the list, so “New Contact” can add a line with “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Gallabox, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each new contact becomes a sheet row, giving the team a live list outside the inbox.

watchOut: “Add New Row to Sheet” maps values by header or column letter, so check the mapping before “New Contact” runs.
